name: gateway
description: Show it once. Call it as an API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n portal,api,studio -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/portal" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/studio"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/definition && npm run build -w packages/recorder && npm run build -w apps/portal && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/cli && npm run build -w apps/studio
scripts.test:browser: GATEWAY_BROWSER_TESTS=1 npm run test -w packages/recorder -w apps/api
scripts.worker:lint: cd workers/jev && uv run ruff check .
